data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, the name "Enayat" signifies the concept of the eternal and unchanging soul or Atman. It is a reminder of the true self that transcends the physical body and remains constant throughout the cycle of birth and death. This notion emphasizes the importance of self-realization and the pursuit of spiritual growth above material possessions or worldly accomplishments. By embracing the spiritual significance of the name, an individual can strive towards achieving a deeper understanding of the self and the ultimate reality.
